meals.name: Sheet Pan Honey Garlic Chicken with Roasted Broccoli and Carrots
meals.description: Crispy chicken and tender vegetables coated in a sweet and savory honey-garlic sauce, all roasted on one sheet pan for easy cleanup. Cook time: ~45 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large sheet pan with parchment paper for easy cleanup.
Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk together honey, soy sauce, garlic powder, and sesame oil to create the honey-garlic sauce. Set aside.

Step 3: Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch bite-sized pieces. Chop broccoli into bite-sized florets and slice carrots into 1/4-inch thick coins. In a large bowl, toss the chicken, broccoli, and carrots with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Step 4: Spread the chicken and vegetables in a single layer on the prepared sheet pan. Roast for 15 minutes.

Step 5: Remove the sheet pan from the oven. Drizzle the honey-garlic sauce over the chicken and vegetables, tossing gently to coat. Return to oven and roast for another 10-15 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through (internal temperature 165°F / 74°C) and vegetables are tender-crisp. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Slow Cooker Italian Meatball Subs
meals.description: Flavorful homemade meatballs simmered in marinara sauce all day, then served in toasted hoagie rolls with melted mozzarella for an easy weeknight meal. Cook time: ~6 hours (slow cooker), 20 minutes active.
instructions: Step 1: In a large bowl, combine ground beef, ground pork, breadcrumbs, egg, diced onion, garlic powder, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Mix gently until just combined (do not overmix). Form into 1.5-inch meatballs.
Step 2: Place meatballs into a 6-quart slow cooker. Pour marinara sauce evenly over the meatballs.
Step 3: Cover and cook on LOW for 6-8 hours or on HIGH for 3-4 hours, until meatballs are cooked through and tender.

Step 4: About 10 minutes before serving, preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) or broiler. Carefully slice hoagie rolls lengthwise, leaving one side attached. Fill each roll generously with meatballs and sauce, then top with shredded mozzarella cheese.

Step 5: Place filled hoagie rolls on a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly and rolls are lightly toasted. Alternatively, broil for 1-2 minutes, watching carefully to prevent burning. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Speedy Shrimp Scampi with Linguine
meals.description: A classic Italian-American dish featuring succulent shrimp quickly sautéed in a garlicky lemon-butter sauce, tossed with linguine. Cook time: ~25 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Cook linguine according to package directions in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining. Meanwhile, pat shrimp dry with paper towels and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Step 2: In a large skillet over medium heat, melt 2 tablespoons of butter with 2 tablespoons of olive oil. Add garlic powder and crushed red pepper flakes; cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Step 3: Add shrimp to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and opaque. Remove shrimp from skillet and set aside.

Step 4: Pour white wine into the skillet, scraping up any browned bits. Squeeze in the juice from half of the lemon. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted, then add reserved pasta water as needed to create a light sauce consistency.

Step 5: Add the cooked linguine and shrimp back into the skillet. Toss to coat everything in the sauce. Stir in chopped fresh parsley. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt, pepper, and more lemon juice if desired. Serve hot.

meals.name: Korean Ground Beef and Rice Bowls
meals.description: Quick and flavorful ground beef simmered in a sweet and savory Korean-inspired sauce, served over fluffy rice with fresh, crisp vegetables for a satisfying bowl meal. Cook time: ~35 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Cook jasmine rice according to package directions. While rice cooks, prepare the sauce and beef.
Step 2: In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic powder, grated ginger, and red pepper flakes (if using). Set aside.

Step 3: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet or non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes. Drain any excess grease.
Step 4: Pour the prepared sauce over the cooked ground beef. Stir well to coat and simmer for 2-3 minutes, allowing the sauce to thicken slightly and flavor the beef.

Step 5: To assemble bowls, divide cooked rice among four serving bowls. Top each with a generous portion of the Korean ground beef. Garnish with shredded carrots, sliced cucumber, and sliced green onions. Serve immediately.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Crispy Fish Sticks with Homemade Tartar Sauce and Sweet Potato Fries
meals.description: Golden, crispy fish sticks baked in the oven alongside sweet potato fries, served with a tangy homemade tartar sauce for a fun and easy family dinner. Cook time: ~35 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Step 2: Wash and peel sweet potatoes, then cut them into 1/4-inch thick fries. In a large bowl, toss the sweet potato fries with olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
Step 3: Spread the sweet potato fries in a single layer on one half of the prepared baking sheet. Bake for 15 minutes.
Step 4: While fries bake, prepare the tartar sauce: In a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, pickle relish, lemon juice, and chopped fresh dill. Mix well and refrigerate until serving.

Step 5: After 15 minutes, remove the baking sheet from the oven. Add the frozen fish sticks to the other half of the baking sheet, ensuring they are in a single layer. Flip the sweet potato fries. Return to oven and bake for another 10-15 minutes, or until fish sticks are golden brown and crispy, and sweet potato fries are tender and slightly caramelized. Serve immediately with tartar sauce.

meals.name: Chicken and Veggie Quesadillas with Quick Guacamole
meals.description: Cheesy, savory quesadillas packed with seasoned chicken and sautéed bell peppers, served with a simple homemade guacamole. Cook time: ~40 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Slice chicken breasts into thin strips. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken strips and taco seasoning; cook, stirring frequently, until chicken is cooked through and lightly browned, about 6-8 minutes. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.

Step 2: Add sliced bell peppers and onion to the same skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender-crisp, about 5-7 minutes. Remove vegetables from skillet and combine with the cooked chicken.
Step 3: While vegetables cook, prepare the guacamole: Mash avocados in a medium bowl. Squeeze in juice from half a lime, stir in chopped fresh cilantro, and season with salt to taste. Mix well.

Step 4: Wipe the skillet clean (or use a separate griddle). Heat over medium heat. Place one tortilla in the skillet. Sprinkle about 1/4 cup of cheese over one half of the tortilla, then add a portion of the chicken and veggie mixture over the cheese. Top with another sprinkle of cheese.

Step 5: Fold the empty half of the tortilla over the filling. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and the cheese is melted. Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling. Slice quesadillas into wedges and serve immediately with quick guacamole.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Italian Sausage and Pepper Hoagies
meals.description: Hearty Italian sausage links roasted with colorful bell peppers and onions, served in toasted hoagie rolls with marinara and melted provolone for a satisfying weekend meal with minimal cleanup. Cook time: ~45 minutes.
instructions: Step 1: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a large sheet pan with parchment paper.

Step 2: Slice bell peppers and red onion into thin strips. In a large bowl, toss the Italian sausage links, sliced peppers, and onion with olive oil, garlic powder, oregano, salt, and black pepper until well coated.
Step 3: Spread the sausage and vegetable mixture in a single layer on the prepared sheet pan. Ensure sausages are not touching for even browning.

Step 4: Roast for 20 minutes. Then, flip the sausages and stir the vegetables. Continue roasting for another 10-15 minutes, or until sausages are cooked through (internal temperature 160°F / 71°C) and vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized.

Step 5: Towards the end of cooking, lightly toast hoagie rolls if desired. Assemble the hoagies by placing a cooked sausage link into each roll, topping with a generous portion of roasted peppers and onions, a spoonful of marinara sauce, and a slice of provolone cheese. If desired, briefly return hoagies to the oven or broiler to melt the cheese. Serve hot.
